description.en: A low-bodied Moeritherium reconstruction with an elongated barrel torso, short legs and a modest muzzle. It combines different individuals; body dimensions and soft tissues are estimates, and no long elephant-like trunk is assumed.
description.zh: Moeritherium的完整复原，具有低矮修长桶状躯干、短腿与适度延长的吻。综合不同个体，身体尺度和软组织为估计，不假定长象鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Proboscidea, Moeritheriidae; early branch, not a modern elephant or hippo.
diagnostic_targets: Very long low barrel trunk and short flexed legs, length-to-shoulder-height about3.3; not a compact baby elephant.
Low elongated skull and modest fleshy muzzle continuous with face, no long hanging trunk.
Small upper incisor tusks with short modest lower incisors, not huge mammoth tusks or hippo canine display.
Short substantial supporting limbs under long trunk, rounded broad feet, no hoof cylinder or horse leg.
Small ears and modest tail, subdued inferred nearly hairless skin, no elephant sail ears or furry mammoth body.
Full animal required; original shape combines low barrel/shortlimbs/modest snout, not merely rescaled other candidate.

scale.scale_status: Living proportions estimates from composite; bone lengths are source values not necessarily same individual.

scientific_limits.en: Larramendi2016 reconstruction combines young skull C.7867 enlarged15% with postcranial bones of different adults.2.30m length,.70m shoulder height and235kg are composite restoration estimates, not measurements of one articulated individual. Humerus240mm/femur270mm are listed source bone lengths. Body width, skin, ears, lips, feet and color remain inferred. Paris display skull photograph is a cast/reconstruction without measured scale or confirmed specimen number. Cranial/neck/mandibular proportions argue against a conventional trunk; do not add one.
scientific_limits.zh: 2016复原将幼颅C.7867放大15%并结合不同成年个体颅后骨，2.30米长/.70米肩高/235公斤为合成复原估计，非单一个体全身实测。肱240毫米/股270毫米为文献列骨长。宽度、皮肤、耳唇足及颜色为推断。巴黎展颅照片为铸件/复原，无实测尺及确认标本号。颅颈下颌比例不支持常规象鼻，不添加长鼻。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Complete living low extremely elongated barrel body with short limbs and modest long muzzle; original618 gate supported by specific2016 research.
